{{figure:fig_2_1.webp}}

The diagram shows the graph of the probability density function, f, of a random variable $X$.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Find the value of the constant $k$.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: Using this value of $k$, find $\text{f}(x)$ for $0 \leqslant x \leqslant k$ and hence find $\text{E}(X)$.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text: Find the value of $p$ such that $\text{P}(p < X < 1) = 0.25$.
